approval_note: all: every Short waits for Charlie's OK; flagged: only Shorts with a reason to look wait (the end goal); none: everything uploads straight away.
note: Two writer runs a day: 06:50 writes up to per_session (7); 12:50 writes the rest of daily_limit (3) from fresher trends. Uploads are capped by YouTube's channel limit: 10 in any 24 hours until the channel has Advanced features (video selfie, under review since 17 October). The YouTube Data API default quota is no constraint: 100 uploads a day plus 10,000 units for other calls. After Advanced features: daily_limit 20, per_session 14, slot_first 08:00, slot_every_minutes 45, slots_per_day 20.
tiktok_note: inbox: the day's 5 TikTok picks land in the TikTok phone app as drafts once scheduled, and Charlie posts them with the captions from the morning message; manual: he uploads them himself in TikTok Studio on desktop; direct: posts by itself (needs TikTok's review).
